items.headline: Use Claude with Researcher in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Researcher now supports multiple AI models including Claude from Anthropic, allowing users to gather, analyze, and summarize information from both the web and internal work content. The feature enables teams to select the best model for specific research tasks directly within the Microsoft 365 workflow.
items.levelshiftAngle: LevelShift's internal M365 Copilot deployment and AI Discovery Workshops can now demonstrate multi-model selection as a concrete productivity pattern for clients evaluating Microsoft 365 investments. Frame this as validation that enterprise AI is moving from single-vendor to best-of-breed orchestration, exactly what our 5-Phase methodology and integration practice (Boomi, MuleSoft) position us to deliver.

items.headline: Anthropic and Salesforce expand partnership to bring Claude to regulated industries
items.summary: Claude is now available as a preferred model for Salesforce Agentforce in regulated industries including financial services, healthcare, cybersecurity, and life sciences. Anthropic is the first LLM provider fully integrated within the Salesforce trust boundary, with all Claude traffic contained within Salesforce's virtual private cloud. Salesforce is also deploying Claude Code across its global engineering organization.
items.levelshiftAngle: Our Salesforce Summit Partner status and Agentforce Ready designation mean this update directly affects active client implementations. LevelShift serves Financial Services (Lereta LLC, FinServ optimisation clients) and Healthcare (NY Blood Center, Mercy workflows) where the trust boundary integration resolves procurement objections we've encountered. Use the Salesforce-corroborated trust boundary claim in RFP responses and compliance conversations this week.

items.headline: Mona by Clinomic delivers 68% reduction in ICU documentation errors across 40 hospitals
items.summary: Mona, an AI medical assistant by Clinomic deployed across 40 hospitals, achieved a 68% reduction in ICU documentation errors and a 33% reduction in perceived workload for clinical care professionals. The system helps doctors and nurses manage intensive care patients with real-time documentation support.
items.levelshiftAngle: Validates the healthcare AI trajectory where LevelShift already delivers (Mercy Health 100,000 hours saved, NY Blood Center CRM). Our SOC 2 and HIPAA-compliant medical record review services position us to replicate this pattern for mid-market hospital systems and health networks. The 68% error reduction metric is exactly the kind of clinical safety ROI that opens procurement doors. Add Mona case study to healthcare pitch decks alongside Mercy.

items.headline: KPMG pulls agentic AI report after hallucination claims surface on June 13, 2026
items.summary: KPMG withdrew its report titled Redefining excellence in the age of agentic AI on June 13, 2026, after multiple organizations disputed claims about their AI deployments and GPTZero documented widespread citation problems. KPMG told TechCrunch it removed the report while reviewing the circumstances around publication, creating a trust issue for one of the biggest advisory brands in enterprise technology.
items.levelshiftAngle: This validates why LevelShift's 5-Phase methodology includes governance playbooks and human-in-the-loop verification at every stage. When a Big Four firm suffers reputational damage from AI output errors, it proves structured execution and quality controls are non-negotiable. Reference this incident in governance workshop conversations and SOC 2 differentiation messaging. Our CMMI certification and disciplined delivery model prevent exactly this failure mode.

items.headline: EU AI Act high-risk deadline deferred from August 2026 to December 2027 via Digital Omnibus
items.summary: The EU AI Act Digital Omnibus agreement (provisional, 7 May 2026) defers the high-risk AI system compliance deadline from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027. Prohibited practices remain enforceable since 2 February 2025, and GPAI model rules since 2 August 2025. The 17-month extension applies to Annex III high-risk systems including those used in financial services and healthcare.
items.levelshiftAngle: Removes immediate August urgency but does not eliminate EU AI Act relevance for LevelShift clients in Financial Services and Healthcare. Our UK and Dubai offices mean clients we serve are in scope of extraterritoriality. The deferral gives us runway to embed governance frameworks into active AI transformation engagements rather than selling standalone compliance sprints. Position the December 2027 deadline as a strategic window to build AI governance into the foundation, referencing our SOC 2 certification and 5-Phase methodology.
